review.notes: A village child (not named; the plan has no name for him) speaks in the first person in Ravi sir's class; Sam is visiting. बच्चो (vocative) and "बच्चों को" are the first plural forms. Honorific plural for रवि सर. Words outside the plan (measured): none.

sentences.text: सैम आज रवि सर की कक्षा में है।
sentences.english: Today Sam is in Ravi sir's class.
The class is big.
Aman is in the class too.

sentences.text: आज एक नया बच्चा भी है।
sentences.english: Today there is a new child too.

sentences.text: रवि सर बोलते हैं, "बच्चो, यह नया दोस्त है।"
sentences.english: Ravi sir says, "Children, this is a new friend."
He says, "Please sit down."

sentences.text: नया बच्चा अमन के पास बैठता है।
sentences.english: The new child sits next to Aman.

sentences.text: रवि सर बोलते हैं, "आप हिंदी में बोलिए।"
sentences.english: Ravi sir says, "Please speak in Hindi."
He says, "Hello, sir!"
"I live in a village."
"My village is very nice."
"My house is big."
"There is a courtyard in the house."
"There is a cow in the courtyard."
"The cow is white."
"In the morning I go to the courtyard."
"I drink the cow's milk."
"The milk is very sweet."
"The city is big, the village is small."
"A man goes to the city every day."
"He sells vegetables."

sentences.text: "मेरे घर में दादी हैं, माँ हैं और पापा हैं।"
sentences.english: "In my house there are my grandmother, my mother and my father."
"Mother makes food in the kitchen."
"Father goes to work every day."

sentences.text: "मैं स्कूल में पढ़ता हूँ। मुझे हिंदी पसंद है।"
sentences.english: "I study at school. I like Hindi."

sentences.text: रवि सर बोलते हैं, "बहुत अच्छा! अमन, आप बोलिए।"
sentences.english: Ravi sir says, "Very good! Aman, you speak."

sentences.text: अमन बोलता है, "सर, मैं यहाँ बैठता हूँ। मैं ख़ुश हूँ!"
sentences.english: Aman says, "Sir, I sit here. I am happy!"

sentences.text: रवि सर बोलते हैं, "आज कौन बीमार है?"
sentences.english: Ravi sir says, "Who is ill today?"

sentences.text: अमन बोलता है, "सर, मुझे खाँसी है।"
sentences.english: Aman says, "Sir, I have a cough."

sentences.text: रवि सर बोलते हैं, "आपको आराम चाहिए।"
sentences.english: Ravi sir says, "You need rest."

sentences.text: वह बोलते हैं, "आप डॉक्टर के पास जाइए।"
sentences.english: He says, "Go to the doctor."
"The doctor gives medicine."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "सर, मेरे सिर में दर्द है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Sir, I have a headache."

sentences.text: रवि सर बोलते हैं, "सैम, आपको बुखार है?"
sentences.english: Ravi sir says, "Sam, do you have a fever?"

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "नहीं, सर। मेरे पेट में भी दर्द नहीं है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "No, sir. I have no stomach ache either."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "मेरी आँख भी ठीक है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "My eye is fine too."

sentences.text: रवि सर बोलते हैं, "बीमार को आराम चाहिए।"
sentences.english: Ravi sir says, "A sick person needs rest."
